## Summary

The EP02 Khmer already reads as speech: Petra's clipped work fragments and Hugo's slow, polite questions stay clearly apart, the consent ritual «…បានទេ?» / «បាន។» / «មិនទាន់ទេ។» is natural and consistent, and no line has Hugo ordering her or Petra saying ចង់. Four of Hugo's lines were changed: P7 (a clumsy «មិនមែនត្រឹម» construction, now shorter and fits one bubble line), P25 (bookish «តាមអ្វីដែល» → spoken «តាមដែល», shorter; the fixed EP11 phrase follows), P47 (bare «ដល់នេះហើយ» can be heard as "let's stop here"), and P48's second bubble (worded as what gloves are for, so it is not heard as a rule). The glossary's EP02 section was updated to match (배운 대로, 손끝, 지키다, 반전 짝, ចំអាម note). The script's header table (line 28) and editor's notes still quote the old P7/P25/P47/P48 Khmer; they are not KM lines and were left untouched, so script-editor or continuity-manager may refresh them.

## Decisions

Uncertainty resolved automatically (what was unclear, what was chosen, why).

- **P18 «ធ្វើការបាន។» vs the ritual «បាន។» (K11):** kept. The ritual answer is always a standalone single-bubble «បាន។»; P18 sits in a two-bubble panel right after «ឈឺទេ?», and the front word ធ្វើការ makes it "I can still work", Petra's habit of answering pain with work. The alternative «ការងារ… មិនអីទេ។» would echo EP1 P20 «មិនអីទេឬ?» and is less her voice.
- **P46 «វា… ដល់ណាហើយ?» (K5):** kept. With វា and the panel (she stares at his neck) it reads "how far has it got?"; it stays the twin of EP1 P31 «វា… យូរប៉ុណ្ណាហើយ?». Only the answer P47 needed មក.
- **P48 second bubble (K12, ruling EE/EI F3):** kept, reworded (see Changes). It restates a fact the reader already has from EP1 and the maid scene (gloves keep his skin off others); it does not state a new rule about wanting or judgement. Cutting it would also need a Korean change, which is outside this review.
- **P55 «…ប៉ុន្មាន?» (K9):** kept. A bare «ប៉ុន្មាន?» is exactly how a price is asked in Khmer and also "how many?", so both the price and the remaining-distance reading work, and P56 «…មួយចំអាម។» answers it naturally. «…នៅប៉ុន្មាន?» would announce the clock in his mouth.
- **ចំអាម spelling (K2):** kept as ចំអាម, the standard dictionary form for the thumb-to-middle-finger span; not ចង្អាម. «…មួយចំអាម។» is natural as a one-word measurement answer.
- **Consent ritual (K1):** «…បានទេ?» reads at once as "may I?"; «បាន។» is a short, not curt, yes; «មិនទាន់ទេ។» is soft and keeps "not yet, but some day". No change.
- **Maid register (K3, K4, P36/P37):** kept without ចាស. Both lines are unprompted, urgent explanations, where a trailing ចាស is unnatural; politeness is carried by «លោកម្ចាស់» and the soft «…ទេ». «កំហុស» is the ordinary word in «មិនមែនកំហុស…ទេ» ("not his fault") and puts no blame on herself; «គឺស្រោមដៃ… ធ្លាយ។» names the glove as the cause.
- **Hugo never commands her:** P4, P32, P50 checked. P50 «…អ្នកទទួលតែស្រោមដៃ… ព្រមទេ?» reads as a proposal with a "would you agree?" tag; kept.
- **Petra's commands (K18) P10/P19/P51:** «ដោះចេញ។», «នៅស្ងៀម។», «ដកចេញ។» read as a craftswoman's brisk work instructions in context; kept.
- **P26 «…បានប៉ុន្មានអាទិត្យដែរ។» (K6):** kept; ដែរ + full stop makes it the affirmative "a good few weeks", and ប៉ុន្មាន must stay for the P55 echo (no number words).
- **P13, P24, P29, P30, P34, P40, P41 (K8, K17, K19–K21):** natural as written; double meanings (ស្បែក, ផ្លូវកាត់, ទម្លាប់) intact; kept.
- **Length (P7, P25):** P7 now 22 code points without spaces, P25 27; both should fit one bubble line.

- P46 «វា… ឡើងដល់ណាហើយ?» ("how far up has it climbed?"): more vivid, but breaks the letter pair with P47 and adds a direction the source does not state.
- P25 without ខ្ញុំ («…សាកធ្វើ តាមដែលបានរៀន។»): shorter, but a subjectless verb phrase can be read as an instruction to her.
